description: This file contains functions to validate, read, and modify boot configuration files for a hardware device. It includes functions to verify magic headers, retrieve partition counts and indices, get and set the primary boot partition, and toggle the primary boot setting.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Validates the magic headers of a boot configuration file to ensure it is valid.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Reads and returns the number of partitions from the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Returns the index of a specified partition name within the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Retrieves the primary boot partition index for a given partition name.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot partition for a given partition name.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot setting between 0 and 1 for a specified partition.
